### 📐 AzgaarParser v2.0.0 — The Data Refinery Update

### 🚀 Overview

**AzgaarParser v2.0.0** is a high-performance, asynchronous data refinery toolkit designed to decompose massive, un-nested `.map` and `.json` geographic exports generated by the Azgaar Fantasy Map Generator.

While the previous version relied on heavy engine-side adapters that bottlenecked client-side performance, the v2.0.0 architecture executes a clean, multi-threaded separation pass right at the source. It extracts a single, raw, million-line data drop into a highly modular, decoupled ecosystem of flat database files—stripping out massive topological noise from live gameplay configurations.

---

### ✨ New in v2.0.0 (Major Architectural Overhaul)

*   **Asynchronous Graphical UI:** Features a sleek, dark-themed Java Swing terminal dashboard (`tvi.azgaar.parser.ui.Window`). Parsing runs headlessly on low-level background execution threads (`SwingWorker`), preventing layout freezing or frame stutter.
*   **LogEventBus Telemetry:** Driven by an internal, decoupled event broadcasting array. Processing tasks natively drop status updates to the bus without coupling to UI components, feeding real-time logging diagnostics down the terminal canvas.
*   **Raw Metadata Squashing:** Native array boundary filters automatically detect and purge index-0 primitive artifacts and padding vectors introduced by raw web file exporters, guaranteeing pure JSON object streaming across all loops.
*   **Streamlined Asset Mapping:** Structural lookup gates dynamically adapt to variant data keys (such as tracing `"type"` parameters on environmental markers where typical `"name"` tags do not exist), ensuring absolute recall on complex matrix layers.

## 📦 Installation

This API is hosted and distributed via **JitPack**. Add the repository and dependency to your build configuration:

### Maven (`pom.xml`)

Add the JitPack repository:
```xml
<repositories>
    <repository>
        <id>jitpack.io</id>
        <url>https://jitpack.io</url>
    </repository>
</repositories>
```

Add the dependency:
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.github.Torven-Interactive</groupId>
    <artifactId>Azgaar-Parser</artifactId>
    <version>v1.0.0</version>
</dependency>
```

### Gradle (`build.gradle`)

Add the repository to your root `build.gradle` file:
```groovy
repositories {
    mavenCentral()
    maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' }
}
```

Add the dependency:
```groovy
dependencies {
    implementation 'com.github.Torven-Interactive:Azgaar-Parser:v1.0.0'
}
```

### 🏗️ The 13-Channel Pipeline Output Directory

Running a raw file compilation pass builds out a pristine, decoupled directory workspace. This allows game clients to load data sheets headlessly into local registries on boot, or grants modders immediate, clean text access to alter values without touching engine code:

text

    📁 definitions/
    ├── 📄 biomes.json              <-- Global climate specifications and color matrices
    ├── 📄 mesh.json                <-- Monolithic 2D/3D topological vertex grids & cellular lattices
    📁 cultures/
       └── 📄 [name]_[id].json          <-- Ethnic tradition trees, weights, and heritage indexes
    📁 religions/
       └── 📄 [name]_[id].json       <-- Global faith organizations and spiritual layout blocks
    📁 name bases/
       └── 📄 [name]_[id].json           <-- Linguistic syllable structures for territory names
    📁 burgs/
       └── 📄 [name]_[id].json      <-- Individual urban center sheets stripped of visual mesh nodes
    📁 states/
       └── 📄 [name]_[id].json      <-- Sovereign nation configurations stripped of raw boundary arrays
    📁 provinces/
       └── 📄 [name]_[id].json      <-- Sub-state regional profiles and localized demographics
    📁 rivers/
       └── 📄 [name].json           <-- Hydrological systems, width indexes, and discharge factors
    📁 routes/
       └── 📄 [group]-[id].json     <-- Commercial infrastructure paths and vector connections
    📁 markers/
       └── 📄 [type] - [id].json    <-- Interactive point-of-interest indicators (mines, ruins, dens)
    📁 zones/
       └── 📄 [name]_[id].json          <-- Macro climate bands and environmental boundary regulations
    

Use code with caution.

---

### 🔌 Integrating the Output Files

The generated files are tailored specifically for high-speed object mapping. In your game client engine, you no longer need to write heavy text parsers. Simply anchor a standard GSON loop inside your boot loaders to hydrate your live game registers headlessly:

java

    // Example: Hydrating your commercial nation registers in one line
    State state = gson.fromJson(new FileReader("definitions/states/1_France.json"), State.class);
    

Use code with caution.
